first_observation.note: first observation; the set is development from this date

name: heldout-v1
sampling_rule: Per release (quota trace2code=20, edit2ripple=12, comment2context=18): sort samples by (language, sample id) where language is the majority file-extension language of the gold paths plus the changed file (ties alphabetical); select index floor(i*N/n) for i in 0..n-1; verify every gold path is a kind:file row of corpus/<release>/OWNER__NAME/COMMIT.chunks.jsonl; on failure drop and take the next not-yet-selected sample in the same order. No difficulty judgement. Sources: released ARB v2_trace2code, v2_edit2ripple, v2_comment2context; v2_code2test and v2_abstention excluded (development).
